entry.name: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
entry.note: Code-first: you train real models in lesson one and earn the theory afterward

covers: building and deploying deep learning models
reading.format: Free online course with lessons and a forum for sharing projects.
reading.summary: A free course that teaches people with some coding experience how to apply deep learning and machine learning to practical problems. It uses the fastai library and PyTorch, starting with working examples and gradually exploring how the tools are built. By the end of the second lesson, learners have built and deployed their own deep learning model.
reading.audience: People with some coding experience who want to learn how to apply deep learning and machine learning to practical problems. No prior machine learning experience is required.
